For a gluten-free all-purpose flour substitute that yields an airy loaf, the best option is a high-quality 1:1 gluten-free baking flour blend. These blends typically contain a mix of rice flours, tapioca starch, and potato starch, and crucially, they include xanthan gum or guar gum. These gums mimic the elasticity of gluten, which is essential for trapping air bubbles and preventing the bread from becoming dense or crumbly. Look for blends specifically labeled for bread or yeast baking, as they may have adjusted starch ratios for better rise.
